decisions.reason: As a newly launched, highly visible product line that builds directly on the firm's core office offer and strategic move toward flexible workplaces, management is likely to stay committed and interpret any early weakness as temporary.
The chair family is close to the established range and was given its own page, so the firm has both strategic fit and visible commitment that make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although more accessory-like than core casegoods, this multi-model line still builds on the firm's design-led interior concept and public launch, encouraging management to continue rather than retreat quickly.

The soft upholstered sofa fits the firm's broader interior solutions offer, but because website commitment was weaker than for the other launches, it is somewhat more exposed if initial reception disappoints.
A high standing table matches the firm's stated direction toward adaptable workplace settings and was prominently presented, which supports continued backing despite normal launch uncertainty.

The rug collection is the most distant from the firm's traditional offer, so it faces the greatest risk, but the dedicated presentation and investment in a full collection still make management likely to persist for now.
